title: Add integrity checks to Sprite VM sync pulldown
overview:
syncProjectFromVM() in src/fs/sync.ts blindly overwrites host project files with whatever the VM archive contains. When VM extraction fails silently (e.g., tar exit code 2 producing null-byte files), the pulldown overwrites the host's good files with corrupt data, requiring manual git recovery.

**Motivation:** A dogfood run (2026-02-18) caused full project corruption when the VM had null-byte files from a failed tar extraction. syncProjectFromVM pulled a 596KB archive for a 68MB project and silently overwrote everything. Only git checkout -- . saved the project.

**Success criteria:**
- Archive size sanity check: reject VM archives dramatically smaller than the upload archive
- Spot-check at least one known file for non-null/non-empty content before overwriting
- Log clear warnings when integrity checks fail
- Never overwrite host files when integrity checks fail
- Add tests for integrity check scenarios

**Technical constraints:**
- Must not add significant latency to the sync pulldown path
- Should work with any project size (can't hardcode thresholds)
- The upload archive size should be stored/passed for comparison
- Must maintain backward compatibility with existing sync callers

**In scope:**
- src/fs/sync.ts: downloadFromSpriteVM, extractProjectArchive, syncProjectFromVM
- Archive size comparison logic
- File content spot-checking
- Tests for corrupt archive detection
**Out of scope:**
- Fixing the root cause of tar exit code 2 on Sprite VMs (separate issue)
- Changes to the archive creation or upload paths
- VM filesystem debugging

**Signals:** priority: high, urgency: Data safety - prevents silent project corruption
